# s1d1-tantive

> Decision service for LLM routers. It serves the s1d1 model (a complexity score, a task among 19 and a needs-tools flag, from one pass over the prompt) as System One, OpenAI Decisions, chat-completions, vLLM `/classify` and TEI `/predict`. FastAPI and ONNX Runtime on CPU; one signed multi-arch image per variant (`full`, `compact`, `small`, `tiny`).

## How to choose

- Variant: `small` by default, `full` for the largest model, `tiny` for 512 MiB hosts.
- Formats: `systemone` for LiteLLM 1.106+ (Auto Router, `oss_classifier`, provider `laya`), `chat` for older LiteLLM, `decisions` for OpenAI Decisions clients, `classify` or `predict` for other clients (`S1D1_FORMATS`).
- Target: Azure, AWS, Cloud Run, Heroku, Render or a Hugging Face Space under `deploy/`; Docker anywhere else.
- Replicas: 3 at least; `1000 / cost_ms` requests per second each, with `cost_ms = fixed_ms + per_token_ms × tokens`.
- Deadline: `S1D1_DEADLINE_MS` below the LiteLLM classifier timeout (1000 ms), above the cost of a 1 024-token prompt.
- Long prompts: keep `head_tail`; `chunks` costs about 2.3 passes per long prompt for no measured gain.
- Tiers: LiteLLM's four (`SIMPLE`, `MEDIUM`, `COMPLEX`, `REASONING`) are always recognised; other routers' names go in `S1D1_TIERS`. LiteLLM fallback: `classifier_fallback: default_model`.
- Check: LiteLLM's `test_routing`, then the `ready` line of the logs (`predicted_ms_1024`, `capacity_warning`).
- The calculation and two worked examples: [sizing](docs/sizing.md). Six full configurations: [use cases](docs/use-cases.md).

## Guides

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): run the image, read `/info`, make a first call on each format.
- [LiteLLM](docs/litellm.md): register the classifier and the Auto Router, by the GUI or `curl`, and test the routing.
- [Formats](docs/formats.md): request and response of System One, Decisions, chat-completions, `/classify` and `/predict`.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every environment variable, warm-up, load shedding and metrics.
- [Sizing](docs/sizing.md): the cost model, replicas, memory, deadline, with worked examples.
- [Use cases](docs/use-cases.md): six ready-made configurations, from a pilot to a closed network.
- [Capture](docs/capture.md): keep the classified prompts in JSONL files (opt-in), mount a volume, ship the files, or opt in to send them to the community ingestion.
- [Verify the image](docs/verify.md): signature, SLSA provenance and weights checksums.

## Optional

- [Deploy guides](deploy/): one folder per target, same image and variables everywhere.
- [Maintainers' notes](MAINTAINERS.md): develop, release, add a format or a target.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): supported versions and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release.
